headline: Your people are already using AI. Make it safe, then make it useful.
sub: A vendor-neutral program for Philippine organisations. We measure how your staff use AI, write the rules with your leaders, and train every team on their own documents. Every session leaves you with something you can use the next day.
promise: In one quarter you will know what AI is doing inside your organisation. You will have a signed policy your people understand, staff who can spot a fake and write a good prompt, one working automation, and data that shows whether behaviour changed.

proofPoints.label: Credentials
proofPoints.text: Head of Tech Operations at Rappler from 2018 to 2023, during the height of attacks on press freedom, where security and disinformation were daily work. I built PHVote, Rappler's election-results platform, and ran it through the 2019 and 2022 national elections. Before that, systems analyst at Philippine Savings Bank.

proofPoints.label: Method
proofPoints.text: Simplify, then do. Each module opens with one concrete demo, then puts your team to work on your own documents and processes. No slide marathons.

proofPoints.label: Artefacts
proofPoints.text: Every session produces something you keep: a draft AI policy, process maps, vendor scorecards, prompt libraries, a working automation, a tested prototype agent.
